info.title: NSBM SportsHub REST API
info.description: Same-origin cookie sessions, JSON requests, CSRF protection, student/admin authorization and TOTP. All local timestamps use Asia/Colombo. PUT replaces an administrative record. No bearer tokens or wildcard CORS.
